title: Japanese-Style Black Bean Dumplings
description: A unique fusion of Japanese and South American flavors, these dumplings feature tender black beans and a crispy, savory exterior.

ingredients.name: Luxuriantly fatty Russian black truffle oil

instructions: 1. In a medium bowl, mix together cooked black beans, truffle oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, and grated ginger.
2. Lay a dumpling wrapper on a clean surface and place 1 tablespoon of the black bean mixture in the center of the wrapper.
3. Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
4. Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
5. Press the edges together to seal the dumpling, making sure they are completely closed.
6. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
7. In a large pot or steamer, bring 2 inches of water to a boil.
8. Place the dumplings in the steamer, leaving about 1 inch of space between each dumpling.
9. Cover the pot and steam the dumplings for 8-10 minutes, or until they are cooked through.
10. Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
